summary: Experienced HR Generalist with a 9‑year career in military and corporate environments, skilled in recruitment, benefits administration, policy development, and conflict resolution.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Recruited and managed HR operations for a new branch in Germany, guiding startup and full‑spectrum HR programs.
Developed HR policies, procedures, benefits databases, and orientation, training, and incentive programs.
Managed leave of absence programs, personnel records, benefits enrollment, and HR budget.
Launched US Army office, implementing training, compensation, benefits, incentives, and new employee orientation.
Improved employee retention to 89% and negotiated salary offers and relocation packages.
Ensured workers' compensation compliance and reduced benefits costs by 15% annually.
Authored employee manual covering disciplinary procedures, FMLA, and benefits.
Introduced a formal performance review program and revised job descriptions across all levels.

experience.title: Supervisor
responsibilities: Led HR functions for a home healthcare company with 4,500 professionals.
Recruited, trained, and managed employees; administered benefits; oversaw disciplinary action; maintained HR records.
Co‑chaired flexenrollment meetings, resolved conflicts, coordinated health fairs, and performed exit interviews.
Trained management on interviewing techniques and best practices.
Co‑developed standardized disciplinary procedures and incentive programs, boosting employee satisfaction.
Reworked orientation program and reduced reliance on external recruiters.

experience.title: HR Representative
responsibilities: Handled recruiting, training, benefits administration, disciplinary action, and HR records management.
Co‑chaired flexenrollment meetings, resolved conflicts, coordinated health fairs, and performed exit interviews.
